title: MagicPIG: LSH Sampling for Efficient LLM Generation
technique: LSH-sampling attention with CPU-side hash tables for long-context decoding

optimized_metrics.evidence: MagicPIG can improve decoding throughput by up to $5\times$
achieve 54ms decoding latency on a single RTX 4090
while preserving high accuracy for diverse tasks

headline_claim.text: MagicPIG can improve decoding throughput by up to $5\times$ across various GPU hardware and achieve 54ms decoding latency on a single RTX 4090

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. "decoding latency" taken as per-step latency of a single sequence.
